articles.title: Putin warns West that Russia is prepared to use ‘all weapons’ to protect Kaliningrad - CNN
articles.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin has warned the West against escalating the war in Ukraine, saying Moscow is prepared to use “all weapons” in its arsenal — including nuclear — if its Baltic exclave of Kaliningrad comes under attack.
